text:
sam_platform: Quick handoff — OptKit final smoke tomorrow 09:30 PT. Please confirm owners for quant recs, batching, and canary gate.
maria_ml: I can own quantization recommendations + regression guardrails. I’ll run the quant sweep on the small corpus and post numbers.
andrew_dev: I’ll do batching/caching sanity checks and CR for the runtime changes (PR #4521). tagging @sam_platform for review
olivia_pm: owners noted. timeline: smoke 9:30, canary 11:00, wider rollout 15:00 if no regressions. Dependencies: eng-runtime needs the KV cache hotfix deployed, and eng-sre needs canary routing rule.
chris_sre: KV cache hotfix is staged on canary infra — need the deploy job to unblock. I’ll create the routing rule after the canary tag is applied. ping me when PR is merged.
maria_ml: quick plan: run quant profiles q8/q4-mixed on subset A/B, check ppl/perplexity + token-match regression alert. If delta > 2% we rollback. I’ll post results in this thread.
andrew_dev: batching checklist for smoke:
``` 
- run ./tools/simulate_batch.sh --rate 50 --seq 512
- check latency p95 < 120ms
- check throughput stable for 10m
- verify kv cache hit rate >= 60%
```
sam_platform: can we also run the prefix-cache replay on the canary model? last time we saw prefix drop on long tails.
maria_ml: yes will run prefix replay. also adding eval hook for the new regression-alert pipeline: eval set + trigger threshold.
andrew_dev: PR #4521 is ready for review, small change in scheduler to avoid empty-batch windows. @sam_platform can you take a quick look?
sam_platform: on it, will review within the hour.
chris_sre: deploy-bot wants confirmation to kick canary once PR merged and smoke green.
deploy-bot: build passed for optkit/2025-06-21-sha:abc123; ready for canary if approvals present :white_check_mark:
olivia_pm: approvals: maria_ml ✅, sam_platform (pending), andrew_dev ✅. sam, if you approve we can start canary at 11:00 PT.
sam_platform: LGTM, approved. small comment on a log message but ok to canary.
chris_sre: starting canary deployment at 11:00 PT. I’ll watch p95, error rate, and kv-hit. tagging slack alert channel eng-sre-incidents.
maria_ml: posting preliminary quant numbers: q8 median ppl +0.8%, q4-mixed +1.9% on subset A; regression alert threshold at 2% so q4 is borderline. recommending q8 for initial rollout and schedule q4 follow-up after more evals.
andrew_dev: cache smoke: hit rate 64%, p95 110ms, throughput 28rps stable. no obvious regressions in infra logs. I’ll attach logs to the PR.
sam_platform: good. olivia — do we want the canary to use q8 variant or full float for first wave?
olivia_pm: use q8 variant per maria's rec. keep q4 disabled for now. update rollout plan to include 24-hour eval window and rollback criteria.
chris_sre: canary metrics at +30m: p95 +5ms, error rate unchanged, kv-hit stable. no alerts so far.
maria_ml: running longer prefix replay now (40m). will report if anything crosses threshold.
andrew_dev: flagged one minor race in cache warmup logs — non-blocking but I’ll send a tiny fix later today (will open a follow-up PR).
sam_platform: thanks all. next steps recap:
- merge PR #4521 (andrew)
- deploy canary with q8 (chris)
- run 24h eval & regression monitors (maria)
- hold off q4 until follow-ups (olivia)
- small runtime patch after smoke (andrew)
If anything looks off, call abort and notify eng-sre-incidents.
olivia_pm: added to calendar: optkit-smoke-check 09:30 PT, optkit-canary 11:00 PT. added follow-up sync 16:00 for post-canary review.
maria_ml: prefix replay complete: small drift at tail but within thresholds. final recommendation: proceed with canary using q8. publishing detailed numbers to /internal/optkit/quant/reports.
chris_sre: canary completed at 13:15 PT, metrics stable. promoting to wider pool per rollout plan. will keep 24h watch.
sam_platform: excellent work everyone, thanks. I'll post a quick summary in the delivery channel after the wider rollout is healthy :thumbsup:
olivia_pm: small retrospective note: please link the PR, deploy logs, and quant report in the delivery ticket before close.
andrew_dev: PR #4521 merged, follow-up runtime patch opened as #4530. logs attached in PR.
maria_ml: quant report link: https://internal.redwood/reports/optkit/quant/2025-06-21-q8 (internal only)
chris_sre: closing loop: canary metrics look good at 24h, no regressions. rolling to GA. :tada:
sam_platform: closing thread — great cross-team coordination. If anyone needs to revert, use rollback-2025-06-21 tag and ping eng-sre.
